description: Measures a company reports outside its GAAP statements, as it defines them: `operating` KPIs (users, subscribers, paid memberships, bookings, stores, RevPAR, deliveries, backlog, remaining performance obligations), `non_gaap` measures (adjusted EPS, adjusted operating income, EBITDA, FFO for a REIT, core earnings, with the reconciling figures held), `bank` metrics (CET1 and other capital ratios, net interest margin, efficiency ratio, average balances and yields, credit quality) and `insurance` metrics (premiums, underwriting results, combined and loss ratios, investment income, float, book value). Default: every kind this company reports. These are the company's own definitions from its filings or earnings release. Every period in the latest record by default, or the periods named by `period`. Actual dollars (not millions), shares split-adjusted, a foreign issuer's figures in US dollars.

period.description: Fiscal period: 'FY2025', 'Q2 FY2027' (also 'FY27Q2', 'Q2 2027'), 'latest', 'latest quarter', 'latest annual', 'ttm', 'ytd', 'annual', 'quarterly', 'all', or a period-end date. The company's own fiscal years. Omit for every period in the latest record. A period earlier than the data held returns that the data does not go back that far, and what is held.

ticker.description: Ticker symbol, case-insensitive. Examples: NVDA, brk-b, BRK.B.
